x: Mitcham seemed to be leading Surrey by a few points with ourselves third, and it looked as if we would have to put in a lot of running in the second lap to gain the points required to put us close up to Mitcham and Surrey.

Close (S.A.C.) had an easy win and was followed home by two of our stalwarts, Carter and Jerman. The team race resulted in a dead heat between Mitcham A.C. and ourselves, both teams scoring 26 points.
Close (S.A.C.) was again the winner, with W. Hewitt, of ours, running in excellent style, second.
Handicap.—(1) Jeal, 40ft. 5; (2) Crawley; (3) Sutton. Surrey County 880 Yards Scratch Race.—(1) Close (Surrey A.C.); (2) Mead (H.H.H.); (3) Atkinson (S.L.H.). 1.59.

Wilson, of the Polytechnic, beat Frank Close in the 1 Mile, but a club mate of the latter, J.

We scored a fairly comfortable win over our opponents, who had Frank Close, the English International running for them. Fred Clay ran well in the 100 Yards and also won the Long Jump for the Club, and we were pleased to see Tom Wiley out again.
Three Miles Team Race—1 Cohen, 15.47; 2 Close (Epsom); 4 Beer; 6 Morrell; 8 Main; 12 Shaw; 13 Speaight; 14 Shields; 23 Jannaway; First team—28 points, 4 to score.
